faq.title: FAQ — Lobunta Lubricants
faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Some of the questions we most often receive from industrial customers.
faq.body:
Are the products guaranteed genuine?

Yes. We are an Authorized Distributor of Pertamina Lubricants under Agency No. C 705106, so all products are guaranteed genuine and sourced directly from Pertamina.

Is there a minimum order?

There is no minimum order for retail purchases. For wholesale pricing and recurring supply contracts, please contact our team for a special quotation.

Which payment methods are available?

We accept bank transfer and cash payment. For corporate customers, payment options can be arranged according to the contract agreement.

Can you deliver outside the city?

Yes. We distribute products throughout Indonesia through logistics partners, with estimated delivery times adjusted to the destination.

Do you provide technical support?

Yes. Our technical team is ready to help recommend the right lubricant grade for your machine type and operating conditions.

How do I get a price quotation?

Send us your requirements through the Contact page or WhatsApp. Include product type, quantity, and delivery location for a faster response.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This page explains how Lobunta Lubricants collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacyPolicy.body:
Data we collect. We collect your name, phone number, email address, and messages you submit through the contact form or WhatsApp.

Use of data. This data is used only to answer inquiries, fulfil quotation requests, and process product orders.

Data sharing. We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties.

Security. Data is stored on servers with restricted access and used only by authorised personnel.

Your rights. You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data by contacting us through the contact page.

termsConditions.title: Terms & Conditions
termsConditions.heading: Terms & Conditions
termsConditions.intro: By using our services and conducting transactions with Lobunta Lubricants, you agree to the following terms and conditions.
termsConditions.body:
1. Scope. These terms and conditions govern the use of our site and the purchase of products and services from Lobunta Lubricants.

2. Orders. An order is valid once confirmed by our team, whether by email, phone, or WhatsApp.

3. Pricing. Listed prices may change at any time without prior notice. The final price follows the official quotation we send.

4. Payment. Payment is made according to the method and period agreed upon at order confirmation.

5. Delivery. Delivery times are estimates and may be affected by stock availability and third-party logistics services.

6. Product warranty. All products we sell are guaranteed genuine from Pertamina. Claims for damaged or non-conforming products must be submitted promptly after receipt.

7. Limitation of liability. We are not liable for indirect losses arising from the use of products contrary to our technical recommendations.

8. Governing law. These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws applicable in the Republic of Indonesia.
